technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage Spring XD module architecture for constructing custom source and sink modules.
Implement mass data ingestion (U1) using Spring Batch with JDBC partitioners and HDFS/GPDB writers.
Evaluate Kafka's lower-level SimpleConsumer API (U2) for manual partition assignment and offset commit management.
Extend the Spring XD Admin Server REST API (U3) with a multipart file upload endpoint to receive and register uber-jar modules.
Build the generator source (U5) using multi-threaded payload generation configured via standard Spring XD module parameters.
Implement the perf-meter sink (U6) with atomic counters and periodic logging using SLF4J/Logback to track message rate and throughput.
Use EmbeddedKafka / Testcontainers for automated Kafka source and sink integration testing in CI builds (U8).
assumptions: Development and testing environment already has access to a working Spring XD single-node setup, Hadoop/HDFS test cluster, and database instance.
The developer has requisite expertise in Java, Spring Framework, Kafka, and Spring XD architecture.
CI/CD pipeline infrastructure (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins) is available and supports running Kafka integration tests.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement a mass ingestion job/module to transfer data from relational databases into HDFS, HAWQ, and GPDB efficiently using parallel JDBC readers and batch writers.
Research Kafka Simple Consumer API functionality, prototype manual offset/partition control, and document findings, architecture approach, and recommended next steps.

activities.activity_name: Custom Module Uber-Jar REST Upload API (U3)
activities.activity_description: Develop a REST API endpoint in the Spring XD Admin server to accept custom uber-jar module uploads and register them into the module registry.

activities.activity_name: Spring XD Kafka Provisioning Sample Reference App (U4)
activities.activity_description: Create and publish a sample GitHub reference project demonstrating Spring XD cluster deployment configured with Kafka as both the message bus and stream source.
Implement the 'generator' source module allowing configurable message count (--numMsgs), message payload size (--msgSize), and concurrency (--numThreads).
Implement the 'perf-meter' sink module to aggregate incoming message counts and output timestamped throughput statistics and rates to container log files.
Setup and execute the 'generator | perf-meter' stream in a single-node Spring XD container to ingest 1M messages (1000 bytes, 1 thread) and document performance metrics.

activities.activity_name: Kafka Source and Sink CI Test Coverage (U8)
activities.activity_description: Develop automated unit and integration tests using EmbeddedKafka for Kafka source and sink modules and integrate them into CI build pipelines.
